card.name: Verb right after a subject noun phrase
card.fires_on: The main verb (is, are, do) or a subject word like I that comes right after a short subject noun phrase, usually before words such as required, recommended, not or accepted.

modes.label: Is/are after an action noun

modes.label: Subject word before will
modes.description: A pronoun or sentence opener where a future or intent verb comes next.

card.writes: It pushes toward future or statement verbs like will and away from verbs of change such as goes, becomes, starts.
card.plain: It fires on the verb that comes just after the subject, when a rule or recommendation is about to be stated.
